observedSourceFacts.fact: Existing hold fixture refuses existing private state, seeds a new site/owner/catalogue, selects fresh app/API/TLS ports and fresh identity/checkout/cookie secrets. Gateway is constructed once and request bridge closes over it. No reload/rebind control exists. FINISH runs all-client/TLS/API cleanup.

Canonical guard requires a live original runner with matching command, labels on container/volume/network, DB marker, REST run marker and original-runner REST listener. Root redacted PRESERVED_RUNTIME_RECONNECTION_02 reports54685 exited and55109 alive. Existing app responses do not prove a new launcher can pass this guard. Do not fake PID/labels or weaken fresh-run checks.

Client supervisor binds launching parent and fixture runner, then stops child group when either disappears; no existing ownership-handoff message is supported. Killing55109 can remove all three app groups. stopOwnedClientRuntime also refuses unregistered external children.

Production launcher always builds after spawn and before listen; currently no validated start-prebuilt path. Dynamic PID-owned Next output directories mean merely copying .next or using --start is unsupported.

Private state schema contains origins/site/login/capabilities but not the generated gateway identity keys, checkout signing secret or Accounts cookie secret. Those remain closure/child-binding inputs. A replacement cannot infer or regenerate them and claim unchanged session/handoff continuity. Retained private configuration support is a hard pre-shutdown requirement, not authorization to inspect process memory or dump environments.

Canonical theme update-preview and update routes plus ThemeUpdatePanel already exist. They use target package UUID, exact diff CAS, tenant ownership and canonical publisher. Use these for installed theme version transitions; global catalogue UP alone must not rewrite installed drafts/releases.

limitations: Read-only source and retained redacted receipts only; no process/container/network/database/browser/secret/state probe performed.
No supported runtime-cutover command or state capsule has been proven ready. A normal fixture relaunch is specifically unsafe for the preservation goal.

An explicit preserved-resource ownership transfer must be implemented and independently qualified inside existing canonical tooling if the original-runner guard cannot pass. No ad hoc dead-run adoption or new service/runtime.
